title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time / Master Quest

info.about: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a 1998 action-adventure game developed and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo 64. It was the first Legend of Zelda game with 3D graphics.
info.trivia: A pre-order bonus for The Wind Waker containing Ocarina of Time and the previously unreleased Master Quest.
info.why: Never sold on its own, so copies exist only in the numbers Nintendo pressed for the promotion.
